<noinclude>
This is the "Lab Room" form.

To create a page with this form, enter the page name below;
if a page with that name already exists, you will be sent to a form to edit that page.

{{#forminput:form=Lab Room|autocomplete on category=Lab Room}}
</noinclude>
<includeonly>
<div id="wikiPreview" style="display: none; padding-bottom: 25px; margin-bottom: 25px; border-bottom: 1px solid #AAAAAA;"></div>

{{{for template|Lab Room}}}

{| class="formtable"
|-
! Room Name:
| {{{field|name|mandatory|input type=text|size=50}}}
|-
! Room Number:
| {{{field|room_number|mandatory|input type=text|size=20}}}
|-
! Building:
| {{{field|building|input type=text|size=50}}}
|-
! Floor:
| {{{field|floor|input type=number|size=10}}}
|-
! Capacity:
| {{{field|capacity|input type=number|size=10}}}
|-
! Manager:
| {{{field|manager|input type=combobox|values from category=Personnel|autocomplete on property=Personnel Role}}}
|-
! Description:
| {{{field|description|input type=textarea|rows=5}}}
|-
! Status:
| {{{field|status|mandatory|input type=dropdown|values=Active,Inactive,Under Renovation|default=Active}}}
|-
! Created Date:
| {{{field|created_date|input type=date}}}
|-
! Last Updated:
| {{{field|last_updated|input type=date}}}
|}

{{{end template}}}

'''Free text:'''

{{{standard input|free text|rows=10}}}
</includeonly>
